hypothesis: Accepted full contrast enhancement clears omission evidence solely because imageEnhanced=true, even if the selected words still leave shaded ink uncovered
scope: Warnings after accepted full enhancement only; no new OCR candidate, retry eligibility, gain/minimum/numeric/coordinate or deadline policy
fixedControlledCases: Accepted incomplete: original bottom2 lines at.60, enhanced bottom4 at.90 of frozen8-line shadow
Accepted complete: same original, enhanced all8 at.90
Rejected: same original, enhanced bottom4 at.62
controlledEvidence: Deterministic engine-contract responses derived from frozen native TSVs; confidence fields explicitly controlled, never presented as bundled OCR quality
baselineRequired: Actual converter adopts incomplete full candidate, actual coverage probe returns true for selected words, warning flag/code absent; independent full HTTP/Worker baseline reproduces
fixCriteria: Incomplete accepted result gains OCR_POSSIBLE_TEXT_OMISSION with wording that does not say its adopted candidate was rejected
Complete accepted result has no omission warning
All selected text/digits/confidence/bboxes/source bytes/overlay masks identical before/after
Coverage check uses original pixels/final source coordinates and existing original deadline; partial/deskew/vertical/budget behavior preserved
unaffectedRoutes: TXT->DOCX->PDF->TXT through HTTP with actual Office reopen
stop: No confirmed baseline fault means negative report and stop. Confirmed fault permits smallest warning-only fix and meaningful focused/clean build/actual before-after HTTP evidence; no angle/threshold/PSM sweep
